name: ice1bg
style: Flat 2D illustration, a wide double-page spread from a children's picture book. {subject} No black outlines: shapes are flat colour fills only, every colour with a slightly darker flat shade for simple two-tone shading. Bright cheerful colours, clean simple shapes, lots of calm open space. No text, no letters, no numbers.

items.bg: A flat side view of a sunny Ice Age snowy tundra like a stage set seen straight from the front with no perspective, with NO animals and NO people: a pale blue sky with a few soft white clouds, big pale blue glaciers and white snowy mountains far in the back, a few dark green snowy pine trees at the left and right edges, some grey rocks with snow caps, and a wide flat white snowy ground with soft blue shadows across the whole bottom half of the picture.
